title: Highly Recommend!
text: A true 5 star tour! Alfonso was an incredible host. All the food and wine choices were amazing and I loved hearing the history of each neighbourhood we visited. The absolute perfect introduction to the food, culture and people of Sevilla! Thank you Alfonso you were brilliant!
author: B5087AWsherryh

title: Delicious food + history/culture for a great price!
text: I highly recommend this tour! It’s a great value for the money and we also learnt so much more about the history an culture of Seville. Our guide, Samuel, was great and very knowledgeable about all the places we went as well as the city. The 2 hours flew by and we all left feeling absolutely stuffed! It was a great time :)
author: poojac96

title: Fantastic food tour!
text: Wonderful tour.  Samuel was fantastic!  We learned so much about the history and food of Sevilla.  Thank you Samuel!
author: P4081IMcarolineh

title: An amazing experience!
text: Such a seamless experience. Everything was so easy and smooth. Alfonso was knowledgeable and upbeat. We truly enjoyed every stop made, from the atmosphere to the food. Alfonso made the entire experience wonderful. He really knows his stuff and is very easygoing. It was timed perfectly!
author: 961channingp

title: Great tapas tour
text: Alfonso was a great guide. We had a lot of fun and enjoyed the food and company.
author: Trail61674061017

title: Seville’s tapas with fun facts and great company.
text: Alfonso was brilliant. He was warm and welcoming. His knowledge of Seville with its history and culture was impressive. His love of tapas and the food and drink of the area was excellent. He was a charming host to our group of 11 from US, UK and Poland - we hadn’t met before but we had a splendid evening together. Thank you, Alfonso.
author: leopold25

title: More than Tapas!
text: Outstanding!!!! more than just tapas! We learned history, interesting facts, foods, drinks, and the very best places to go all while enjoying amazing company! What a wonderful, intimate experience of the best Seville has to offer. Alfonso was the best guide I’ve ever had- so intelligent, informed, kind, interesting, and fun!!
author: krispB8132QJ

title: Beautiful ole!
text: Alfonzo was so informative not just about food but Seville too! Thoroughly enjoyed it and tried things I wouldn't usually try. He was also really accommodating for those who didn't eat certain things. Would highly recommend
author: 468amiew

title: Properly local hot gems tour!
text: Fantastic guide, really great insight into local food and culture. Proper local spots! Was really great fun and Alfonso did a really good job at making the whole group feel at ease.
author: M4488WXdanielw

title: Good fun and food.
text: Alfonso was great. As well as taking us to several bars he was knowledgable about the area and its history. Tapas was good and several different drinks too. Small group and a few laughs along the way led to a lovely evening in Seville.
author: Pablovious
